findings: Legacy control solved four of four fresh parameter cases after one bounded repair per case; zero first-attempt successes. This is existing-stack performance on this corpus, not an improvement attributable to the new guidance or a comparison with the prior corpus.
Guided treatment solved two of four cases: one first-attempt and one repaired. Both remaining interpolation cases were ungraded due to provider timeouts, not observed mathematical failures.

Both arms used the same formula representation, model/configuration, objective output contract, native interpreter, independent Gaussian oracle and caps. Model-owned repair context was identical; the default-off schema/prompt/diagnostic bundle was the treatment variable.

The owned diagnostic observer recorded two constant-shadow, one host/markup token and one numerical-literal failure in control; treatment recorded one unknown-name failure. Every diagnostic is sanitized. No offending source, name, value or private reasoning is retained.

Fifteen logical completion calls included thirteen HTTP attempts: eleven reported usage, two timed out with unknown usage; two later logical calls were blocked locally by original-stage capacity/deadline rules. Four logical calls therefore have unknown usage in the existing conservative report.

Two later treatment network stages waited 119994 ms total and recovered service. No stage/epoch lease or call limit was extended, no frozen stage was rerun, and unknown inference cost is not treated as zero.
Only one of four task pairs met five-percent realized-token/call/HTTP matching. One treatment pair used no more compute, but it is not a replicated general mechanism gain.

No constructed candidate failed the unchanged mathematical oracle in this epoch; six stages reached mathematical grading and were accepted. Do not relabel the two ungraded stages or the five parser rejections as wrong mathematical reasoning.

The hosted backend accepted and answered the guide on both network cases, but regex enforcement remains unverified. Two treatment interpolation requests timing out cannot alone identify decoding cost versus transient serving or generation latency.
All predeclared functional, repair and emission signals are false. The fresh corpus is exposed by this run; preserve it as evidence, never tune to it or merge its success with older runs.
assessment.nextGeneralIntervention: Keep guidance experimental/off; do not launch another indefinite emitter retry series. Prioritize the adopted goal's bounded semantic-proof/search capability, reusing the finite workbench, independent verifier and existing obligation graph. Distinguish missing general formal search from exact arithmetic and finite refutation. Any treatment-serving diagnosis must be a separate minimal development-only comparison, not a regrade or claim of cognitive progress.
